messages:
sarah-sales: Hey team — LargeBank wants a 2-week air-gapped POC starting 04/11. Need a consolidated checklist (packaging, install window, cert rotation, SBOM/signing, and a POC price for a single dedicated GPU node). Who can own which pieces?

ian-se: I can own the installer/ops side. Quick q: do they require outbound validation to our signing service, or purely offline signed artifacts? Also full bundle vs delta bundles? :thinking_face: 

eva-soleng: They want minimal payload + delta patching. We can produce a minibundle (runtime + infra, no sample models) — gzipped ~3.2GB. Deltas supported but require signed manifests on our side.

jordan-pm: Pricing side — propose a flat POC SKU: 2-week reserved node + on-prem support. Sales: can we offer a 30% POC credit? Need wording for SOW about upgrade cadence (customer wants monthly patch windows, no forced feature upgrades).

sarah-sales: Sales needs: final SOW wording, minibundle checksum/signing details for legal, and a clear upgrade cadence (what we will push during POC). Also need an activation flow for ops (token, expiry).

secops-bot: Security scan report uploaded for minibundle v1.3 — https://redwood.internal/artifacts/scan/MB-1.3 (sec: high-level summary attached).

ian-se: Installer notes / firewall snippet for on-prem team: 
```
# Air-gapped install - minimal inbound rules
Inbound:
  - 443 from admin workstation (bootstrap/manifest upload)
  - 22 (ssh) from ops CIDR
  - 5000-5010 intra-cluster (gRPC)
Outbound: none required unless using online activation
```
Also: installer supports cert-pinning and can accept an offline activation token (single-use).

eva-soleng: Activation tokens expire by default after 7d; we can increase to 30d on request. For delta updates we require signed manifest + signature bundle attached during upload.

jordan-pm: Upgrade cadence proposal: quarterly feature releases, monthly security patches. For the POC we agree to only monthly security patches unless the customer explicitly opts into features. We'll call this out in the SOW.

sarah-sales: Legal is asking about SBOM and binary signing — do we provide an SBOM export and signed bundles they can verify? Need plain-language paragraph for their security team.

ian-se: Yes — we provide SBOM in SPDX JSON and cryptographic signatures for bundles. Offline-signer tool: ops runs offline-signer verify --pubkey redwood.pub --bundle minibundle.tar.gz.sig. We'll supply public key and verification steps in the SOW.

eva-soleng: Note constraint: older GPU driver stacks (nvidia driver <=450) may require kernel patches to get our optimized kernels. Call this out as a pre-req in the checklist. Also list recommended driver versions in the bundle README.

sarah-sales: Ok — action items: Eva attach minibundle size + delta plan to SOW, Ian produce firewall & activation steps, Jordan draft upgrade cadence paragraph, Pricing confirm POC node price and credit by EOD.

pricing-team: We can offer a 2-week reserved node SKU at $1,500 flat + up to $2k usage cap with a 30% credit applied to usage. Will send formal SKU and invoice terms to @sarah-sales.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: minibundle-1.3 -> staging @ 16:00 UTC.

sarah-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble the SOW and loop in LargeBank legal. Ping me if anything blocks delivery today :thumbsup:
_extra_note: This thread is a single Slack conversation string; messages are prefixed with display names. No title field included per agents.md guidelines.
